axisCoverage.feedback loop: Collect the two missing SOUL-critical answers and let testers inspect the aggregate they consented to create.
axisCoverage.gamification / engagement / immersion: Measure whether the one-more-run loop, control trust, and readable chaos survive actual sessions without retuning from invented data.
axisCoverage.ai / intelligence integration: Keep intelligence deterministic and local; the command post summarizes explicit evidence rather than inferring sentiment.

items.why: The local Pulse already stores distributions and up to 20 redacted flights, but the only home-screen representation is an ON/OFF button with a sample count. The evidence cannot guide a tester or be shared as a bounded aggregate.
items.recipe: Add buildPortablePlaytestPulse() that exports aggregates only, then extract a PlaytestPulsePanel component with sample count, four distributions, privacy boundary, and clipboard export. Render it only when Pulse is enabled and data exists; keep default visitors free of operator clutter.
items.measurement: Pure tests prove no flight IDs, callsigns, free text, or raw flights enter aggregate export. Component coverage verifies accessible labels, distribution counts, clipboard success/failure, and hidden default state. Desktop/mobile dark/light pixel proof is required.

L1.recipe: Render the existing clarity/replay totals in a collapsed local panel.

L2.recipe: Full: extracted component, four distributions, aggregate-only JSON export, accessibility, tests, and rendered-pixel proof.

L3.recipe: Add cohort comparison only after real multi-device receipt import exists; do not invent it locally.

items.why: Replay coverage proves movement, combat commands, and one derived contact enemy but excludes the runtime's deterministic wave plan and formation lane wholesale.
items.recipe: Record a bounded canonical snapshot whenever createWaveDirectorPlan is assigned, fingerprint each snapshot plus the ledger, finalize a planned-pressure receipt at death, persist it with run history, render it beside the fairness receipt, and add a replay-passport lane labeled recorded plan evidence—not actual spawn, physics, or outcome replay.
items.measurement: Pure tests prove stable fingerprints, mutation sensitivity, bounds, and explicit contract language. Death-flow and public-gameplay tests prove the receipt reaches the UI/contract while confidence remains advisory and full wave outcomes remain excluded.

L1.recipe: Fingerprint one current wave-director plan and show it after death.

L2.recipe: Full: bounded multi-wave ledger, death/run-history wiring, UI receipt, passport lane, and regression courts.

L3.recipe: Capture versioned spawn checkpoints and replay them against physics fixtures before raising any confidence ceiling.

items.why: The opt-in receipt measures death clarity and replay intent but omits explicit control trust and threat readability—the two launch-critical preconditions named by the game profile and SOUL.
items.recipe: Extend the existing v1 annotation envelope backwards-compatibly with allowlisted inputTrust and threatReadability values. Add two compact button questions to the Playtest Flight Receipt, include them in portable receipts and Pulse aggregates, and keep legacy two-answer receipts valid but marked signalComplete=false.
items.measurement: Pure tests cover allowlists, legacy compatibility, four-answer signal completeness, and aggregate counts. DeathScreen tests prove the questions are explicit buttons with no free-text path.

L1.recipe: Add one input-trust answer to the local receipt.

L2.recipe: Full: input trust + threat readability, backwards-compatible schema, Pulse aggregation, UI, and tests.

L3.recipe: Correlate the answers with device/input receipt classes only after real participant samples exist.

items.why: The S153 brief says Last closeout: 12d because it reads a stale rolling-status date (S136) even though parseSilSessions already identifies S152 and its 2026-08-12 header.
items.recipe: Derive lastSilDate from allSilEntries[0].date and use the rolling-status text only as a compatibility fallback. Add a mixed-order/stale-header regression court and re-render the canonical brief.
items.measurement: The focused parser/renderer court passes, S153 renders Last closeout: 1d (or 0d under UTC boundary), the brief validator passes, and no session-number fallback is treated as a date.

L1.recipe: Use the latest parsed SIL entry date with a stale-header fallback and regression test.

L2.recipe: Also add a rolling-status freshness probe and closeout repair path.

L3.recipe: Replace every renderer-local SIL date parser with the shared ledger helper across Studio Ops via Ark cargo.
